fact: The Government of Benin, through the School of Digital Professions, launched a national call for applications for OIF D-CLIC digital skills training for young people, per TechAfrica News.

The Beninese government says that, with UNESCO support, Benin was designated first pilot country of the SNAEIA network's AI initiative, whose programme provides training and capacity building in digital tools and skills for young Beninese.
